content: Merikɨtsɨ manata muyuawitsie yuariya nekaniu'enieni yumɨireme teɨteri waniuki hepaɨ ti'eniɨriɨkɨme. Mɨpaɨ me'utiyuatɨ:

content.text: Wikweitsitɨarikaya, witsikemɨtikuxaxatsiwa meta tɨrɨkariyaya takakaɨyari pɨhetsiemieme,

content: Hikɨ hutarieka mɨpaɨ mekaniutiyuani:

content.text: Mɨkɨ kɨtsiyari kananutineikani tsepanetɨ xeitsienituyari wiyari manuyekɨka».

content: Hikɨ 'ukirawetsixi xeitewiyari heimana nauka meta yunaukatɨ memayeneniere mekaniutihɨxima'uni meta nenewieri Kakaɨyari mekaniupitɨani 'uwenitsie maka, mɨpaɨta mete'ikɨhɨawetɨ:
Hikɨta 'uweni manuwe niuki kanayeneni mɨpaɨ 'utaitɨ:
Neɨkiya 'ixɨarariyari Muxa miwewie
Hikɨta niukite waɨkawa nekaniu'enieni, haa 'amɨpa hepaɨ ti'eniɨriɨkɨme, tɨranari mɨtɨrɨkaɨye hepaɨ. Mɨpaɨ mekaniutiyuanekaitɨni:

content.text: rinu 'ixurikiyari 'aixɨa mɨ'ane kaniyetuiriyarieni menakatɨkɨnikɨ, mɨ'itiya meta mutimerɨka».

content: (Rinu 'ixurikiyari kani'inɨariyaritɨni, heitseriemekɨ me'u'uwatɨ memɨte'uximaya mepatsietɨ).
Hikɨ niuki tuayame mɨpaɨ pɨnetiutahɨawixɨ: «'Aixɨa mekani'itɨarieka kemɨ'ane memuta'inierie, Muxa mɨtineɨketsie memɨtekwanikɨ». Mɨpaɨta kanetiniutahɨawe: «'Ikɨ Kakaɨyari niukieya kaniyuritɨni».

Hikɨ hetɨana nekaniutihɨximakeni nenewieri ne'ipitɨanike. Mɨkɨ matsi mɨpaɨ pɨnetiutahɨawixɨ: «Tixaɨ yumarima. 'Ahepaɨ ne nekatini'uximayatametɨni, 'a'iwama memɨyuhekɨata Ketsutsi hetsɨa memiemetetɨtɨ wahepaɨ nepɨti'uximayatame. Kakaɨyari xeikɨa nenewieri kenepitɨaka. Kemɨ'ane mɨyuhekɨata Ketsutsi hetsɨa miemetɨtɨ, mɨkɨ 'iyari kanexeiyani katinihekɨatani».
Kemɨ'ane kawayu meutuxatsie makatei

Manata muyuawi nekaniuxeiya reuyepiekame, meta kawayu heutuxatɨ mana kaniuwekaitɨni. Manakatei Yamɨtikamie meta Yurimaine katinitewakaitɨni. Heitseriemekɨ yatikamietɨ kaniwaranutaxɨrɨwani meta kuyaxa kaniwewieka.
Hɨxiteya tai mɨtaka hepaɨ pɨtiyuxexeiyakai, yumu'utsie waɨkawa kuruna panamanakai, meta kemɨtitewa kana'utɨakaitɨni, peru xewitɨ 'atsipɨkatimaikai kemɨtitewa, mɨkɨ xeikɨa yapɨtimaikai.
'Ixuriki xuriyamakame 'anakatɨtɨ. «Kakaɨyari Niukieya» katinitewaka.
Kuyaximama muyuawitsie miemete mekaneweiyakaitɨni, kawayutsixi memeutuxa wahetsie me'utetɨ meta rinu 'ixurikiyari, mutuxa meta mɨ'itiyatɨka me'anakatɨtɨkaitɨ.

Tetana 'ixipara meutixikakauni kaniwayeneikakaitɨni, kɨmana mɨwatiwitenikɨ nuiwarite. «Pɨtiwa'aitɨa tepɨa 'itsɨyari 'akwetɨ». Mɨkɨtɨtɨ kanihɨkɨtɨni kaxie takari mitiketsini kaxie pɨnameta, Kakaɨyari Naimekɨmɨtɨrɨkaɨye haxɨaya mayanikɨ.
Kamixayatsie meta teurieyatsie mɨpaɨ pɨre'ukai kemɨtitewa: Ti'aitame, te'aitamete tiwa'aitɨwame, meta Kutsiyari wakutsiyari.

Merikɨtsɨ xeime niuki tuayame nekaniuxeiya tau hetsie 'aweme, yunaime wikixi muyuawitsie memuwɨtɨkɨka kaniwahiwiekaitɨni mɨpaɨ tiwakuhɨawetɨ: «Xekenakɨni, xekeneuyukuxeɨri, Kakaɨyari 'ikwai waɨkawa pɨwewieni,

te'aitamete wawaiyari xekeneutikwa'i, kuyaxi wa'ukiyarima wawaiyari, memɨtɨrɨkawi wawaiyari, wakawayutsixi wawaiyari, mɨkɨ wahetsie memutekai wawaiyari, yunaitɨ memuyunɨ'a memɨte'uximayatamete tɨɨri 'ukirawetsixi yunaime wawaiyari».
Hikɨ yeutanaka nekaniuxeiya, meta kwiepa te'aitamete yukuyaxima mewaruwitɨtɨ, mekaniyukuxeɨrieni memitamienikɨ mɨkɨ kawayu hetsie manaka meta kuyaximama wahepaɨtsita.

Hikɨ yeutanaka meta tixaxatame mɨti'itawakai hamatɨana kaniuwiyarieni, kemɨ'ane 'inɨari mɨtiwewiwakai yeutanaka hɨxie, kɨmana mɨtiwa'irɨwiyakai mɨkɨ memitanaki'eri yeutanaka tseyuya mɨkɨ nenewieri memipitɨakai meta 'ɨkiyari memayexeiyakai. Mɨkɨ yuhutatɨ me'ayenenieretɨ harakuna mɨta'atsie 'atsupɨrekɨ mekaneukaxɨriyani.
Hipatɨ yunaitɨ mekaniukwi'iwa kawayutsie manaka tetana 'ixipara wayeneikakaku, meta yunaitɨ memɨte'awɨwawe mɨkɨ wawaiyarikɨ mekaniutihuxani.
